title: Data-driven machine learning model for predicting multi-functional properties of CNT-polymer nanocomposites using conductivity-informed correlation functions
title_zh: 利用电导率信息相关函数预测碳纳米管—聚合物纳米复合材料多功能性质的数据驱动机器学习模型
summary: 该条目提供的是论文题名、出版信息和作者信息，未给出研究摘要。根据题名，该工作围绕利用包含电导率信息的相关函数，构建数据驱动机器学习模型，以预测 CNT-聚合物纳米复合材料的多功能性质展开。具体方法、数据集、性能指标和结论需查阅原文。
abstract: Publication date: 25 August 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 273 Author(s): Kavan Shah, Pinar Acar, Gary D. Seidel

title: Ab initio study of Structural, Electronic, Optical, Magnetic, and Thermoelectric properties of Ba 2 HoXO 6 (X = Rh, Os, Ru) for spintronics application
title_zh: 面向自旋电子学应用的 Ba₂HoXO₆（X = Rh、Os、Ru）结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质的从头算研究
summary: 该研究利用 WIEN2K 中基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算，在 PBE-GGA 近似下研究 Ba₂HoXO₆（X = Rh、Ru、Os）双钙钛矿的结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质。结果表明，这些材料具有间接带隙和半金属性半导体特征，并展示出与可再生能源器件相关的光学与热输运性质。作者认为这些环境友好材料有望用于新型能源与自旋电子学器件。
abstract: In this article, we explore the Ba2HoXO6 (X = Rh, Ru, and Os) double perovskite for its physical properties i.e. structural, electronical, optical, magnetic, and thermoelectric properties of theoretically investigated cubic compounds under PBE-GGA approximation by quantum-based density functional theory (DFT) within WIEN2K software. The structural, electronical, optical, magnetic, and thermoelectric properties of studied materials have been investigated for the energy renewable devices. Electronic properties of studied materials are explained by describing the band gap and density of states under study PBE-GGA approximation and the results abundantly evident that the studied material have indirect band gap and half metallic semiconductor. For optical behavior of studied materials, we analyzed complex dielectric functions, optical conductivity σ(ω), Absorbance α(ω), Reflectivity R(ω), and Loss parameter L(ω). Also, we analyze the thermal behavior of studied materials by calculating charge carrier concentration (n), electrical conductivity σ/τ, Seebeck coefficient (S), thermal conductivity K/τ, specific heat capacity Cv, magnetic susceptibility χ, and power factor theoretically which predict the materials are eco-friendly and could be used in energy renewable devices. These properties are calculated by Boltz-Trap code under Wien2K code. All these properties are studied though first-Principle calculation and leads to new renewable devices.

title: Optimized magnetic pulses could cut memory switching energy by several orders of magnitude
title_zh: 优化磁脉冲可将存储器开关能耗降低数个数量级
summary: 人工智能驱动的信息与通信技术正在以前所未有的速度产生和处理数据。随着互联网搜索、生成式 AI、推荐系统、科学模拟和大语言模型的广泛应用，数据存储、传输与分析需求急剧增长。该报道关注通过优化磁脉冲显著降低存储器开关能耗的潜力。
abstract: Information and communication technologies (ICTs) driven by artificial intelligence (AI) are generating data at an unprecedented rate. Every internet search, AI-generated image, recommendation, scientific simulation and large language model creates and processes enormous amounts of information that must be stored, transferred and analyzed. As AI continues to expand across every sector of society, global demand for data storage and computing is rising dramatically.

title: Quantum computer completes verified task beyond practical reach of classical simulations
title_zh: 量子计算机完成经验证且超出经典模拟实际能力范围的任务
summary: IBM与芝加哥大学研究人员宣布了一项量子计算演示，声称满足“量子优势”的基本标准。该结果旨在表明，在可信计算任务上，量子计算机可被确认超过经典计算机的实际能力。
abstract: IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago announced a demonstration in quantum computing that meets the fundamental criteria for "quantum advantage"—the point where quantum computers can be confirmed to have outperformed classical computers on trusted computations.

title: Phase-synchronized chorus-driven electron precipitation and diffuse aurora during geomagnetic pulsations
title_zh: 地磁脉动期间相位同步的合声波驱动电子沉降与弥散极光
summary: 该研究分析了 Arase 卫星、EISCAT 雷达和极光成像的磁共轭观测事件，揭示地磁脉动周期内合声波、电子投掷角散射、沉降电子通量和弥散极光之间的同步关系。结果表明，合声波驱动的电子散射可导致周期性沉降，并且地磁脉动可能通过调制源电子和促进合声波传播来调控这一过程。研究显示地磁脉动能够在时间和空间上组织合声波驱动的沉降，体现多尺度磁层—电离层耦合。
abstract: Auroral emissions modulated at geomagnetic pulsation periods signal magnetospheric wave–particle interactions, yet how pulsations synchronize chorus waves, electron scattering, precipitation, and aurora has not been fully understood. Here we analyze a well-conjugated event observed by the Arase satellite, the EISCAT radar, and auroral imaging, combining high-time-, energy-, and pitch-angle-resolution satellite measurements with high-energy-resolution ionospheric precipitation measurements. These observations reveal synchronization among chorus waves, electron pitch-angle scattering, precipitating electron fluxes, and diffuse aurora at the pulsation period, linking chorus-driven scattering to periodic precipitation. We further suggest that geomagnetic pulsations regulate chorus waves not only by modulating source electrons but also by facilitating chorus-wave propagation. The westward propagation of the modulated diffuse aurora was consistent with that of the geomagnetic pulsations, indicating that the spatial propagation of precipitation reflected the geomagnetic pulsation structure. These results show that geomagnetic pulsations can organize chorus-driven precipitation in both time and space, revealing multiscale magnetosphere–ionosphere coupling.

title: Systematic screening of brain neurotransmitter enzymes for radical pair mechanism competence reveals quantitative constraints on magnetic field sensitivity
title_zh: 脑内神经递质酶自由基对机制适用性的系统筛查揭示磁场敏感性的定量约束
summary: 该研究以计算方式筛查九种含磷的人脑蛋白，评估其是否满足自由基对机制在生理条件下运行所需的自旋参数条件。结果显示，多数蛋白满足必要但非充分条件，但交换耦合、自由基对生成机制以及稳态调节等因素构成严苛限制。作者认为，目前只有隐花色素作为已确认具有空间分离自由基对的酶，仍是较可辩护的自由基对机制宿主；本文主要贡献是提出可证伪且可实验检验的框架。
abstract: The radical pair mechanism (RPM) is experimentally validated in avian magnetoreception via cryptochrometextsuperscripte̊fref:Xu2021,e̊fref:Hore2016, but whether RPM-competent sites exist more broadly among brain enzymes remains unknown. Here we screen nine phosphorus-containing human brain proteins computationally, assigning cofactor-specific ³¹P hyperfine coupling constants, and find that eight satisfy all seven necessary emphspin-parameter conditions for RPM operation under physiological conditions (50~simicrotesla, 310~K), though these conditions are necessary but not sufficient---the exchange coupling J and radical pair generation mechanism impose additional, often prohibitive, constraints. The dominant discriminant is the ³¹P nuclear spin coherence time, which scales as the sixth power of the electron--phosphorus distance, creating a 64-fold gap between FAD enzymes (160~simicrosecond) and PLP enzymes (2.5~simicrosecond). We identify a complementary trade-off: enzymes with strong hyperfine coupling exhibit fast singlet--triplet mixing but short electron coherence, and vice versa. Density matrix simulation of an 8-spin model predicts a magnetic field effect of -4.4% on the singlet yield of MAO-A-catalysed serotonin oxidation at J = 0 (an upper bound; the 8-spin truncation itself overestimates MFE by sim20--40%); the actual magnitude is negligible at the crystallographic radical pair distance (|J| sim 500--1000~MHz). These findings establish that spin-parameter prerequisites for RPM are broadly distributed across brain enzymes, but simultaneously reveal that the exchange coupling constraint (|J| < 10~MHz required), homeostatic attenuation (7-fold; Table~e̊ftab:extₕₒₘₑₒₛₜₐₛᵢₛ), and CASSCF evidence against SET in MAO-A (Fig.~e̊ffig:casscf_diradical) collectively impose severe quantitative barriers. Cryptochrome---the only enzyme with a confirmed, spatially separated radical pair---emerges as the sole currently defensible RPM host, with a predicted circadian period shift of 2.7--8.2~minutes at Earth's field. The primary contribution is a falsifiable framework with experimentally testable predictions, not a claim that RPM operates in neurotransmitter-metabolising enzymes.
